Medchal-Malkajgiri District before this Hon'ble Court and set-aside the impugned d e t e n t i o n o r d e r p a s s e d b y t h e 2 n d r e s p o n d e n t v i d e No.Rev/C1/LnO/507/2021-C-Section dated 27.05.2021 and confirmation Order vide G.O.Rt.No.1718, dated 31.07.2021 passed by the 1st respondent as being illegal,
arbitrary, improper, unilateral, unconstitutional and violative of Article 21 and 22 of the Constitution of India and to forthwith release the Detenue and to grant such other relief or reliefs ...."

sentences.text:
2. This writ petition is instituted by the cousin of detenu Sabavath Ganesh, challenging the order of detention dated 27.05.2021 made under Section 3 (2) of the Telangana Prevention of Dangerous Activities of Bootleggers, Dacoits, Drug-Offenders, Goondas, Immoral Traffic Offenders,
Land-Grabbers, Spurious Seed Offenders, Insecticide Offenders, Fertilizer Offenders, Food Adulteration Offenders, Fake Documents Offenders, Scheduled Commodities Offenders, Forest Offenders, Gaming Offenders, Sexual Offenders, Explosive Substances Offenders, Arms Offenders,
Cyber Crime offenders and While Collar or Financial Offenders Act, 1986 (Act 1 of 1986).
3. Heard Sri P.Trivikram Reddy, learned counsel for the petitioner and learned Government Pleader for home.
4.

entities.text:
Telangana Prevention of Dangerous Activities of Bootleggers, Dacoits, Drug-Offenders, Goondas, Immoral Traffic Offenders,
Land-Grabbers, Spurious Seed Offenders, Insecticide Offenders, Fertilizer Offenders, Food Adulteration Offenders, Fake Documents Offenders, Scheduled Commodities Offenders, Forest Offenders, Gaming Offenders, Sexual Offenders, Explosive Substances Offenders, Arms Offenders,
Cyber Crime offenders and While Collar or Financial Offenders Act, 1986 (Act 1 of 1986)
entities.label: STATUTE

sentences.text: The order of detention is made on the ground of involvement in five crimes by the detenu.
These five crimes are registered under Section 356, 379, 354, 382 and 323 of Indian Penal Code.
In Cr.No.111 of 2020, it is alleged that the detenu snatched away nuptial thread from the neck of the wife of complainant.
In Cr.No.128 of 2020, it was alleged that the detenue snatched away gold nuptial thread weighing two tulas infront of the house of complainant.
In Cr.Nos.118, 132 & 146 of 2020 also similar allegations were made.
5. It is not in dispute that in all these crimes, the competent Court has granted bail.
Last of the bail order was granted on 26.11.2020 in Cr.No.146 of 2020.
That being so, the order of detention is passed on 27.05.2021.

It is not disputed that after securing bail in the last of the crime on 26.11.2020, no further crime is reported against the detenu in the six months period between the last bail order and the order of detention.

It cannot be said that the crime reported against the detenu are grave and heinous crimes but all are routine offences liable for prosecution by following the procedure under Code of Criminal Procedure before the competent Court.
These crimes cannot attract the disturbance to public order and the order of detention is liable to be set aside.

6. The Writ Petition is accordingly, allowed and the respondents are directed to set the detenue namely Sabavath Ganesh S/o.Balu Nayak Age: 30 yrs, Caste : Lambada, Occu : Coolie R/o.Erlathanda of Khilla Ghanpur Mandal, Wanaparthy District at liberty forthwith if he is no longer required in any other criminal case.
Pending miscellaneous petitions, if any, shall stand closed.
